overview_description.description:
Beltone Holding is a financial services company that specializes in the fields of asset management, private equity, and brokerage. The company serves institutional investors and currently has over 100 institutional customers from all regions of the globe trading with us in all world and Middle East markets.

Beltone Holding was founded in 2002 and headquartered in Cairo, Al Qahirah.

about_short_description.short_description: Beltone Holding is a financial services company that specializes in the fields of asset management, private equity, and brokerage.

product.name: Asset Management
product.description: Manages investment portfolios on behalf of clients to achieve financial objectives through various asset classes.

product.name: Private Equity
product.description: Invests in private companies by acquiring equity stakes to support growth and generate returns.

product.name: Brokerage
product.description: Facilitates buying and selling of securities on behalf of clients in financial markets.

product.name: Leasing
product.description: Offers financing solutions by leasing equipment or assets to businesses under agreed terms.

product.name: Factoring
product.description: Provides financing by purchasing accounts receivable to improve clients' cash flow.

product.name: Consumer Finance
product.description: Offers financial products and services to individual consumers, including loans and credit solutions.
